documents.doc-cz-ms-pha-2026-09-09-8-ad-9-2026-89: On 9 September 2026, under ref. 8 Ad 9/2026-89, the Prague Municipal Court asked the claimant to provide a bank account number so that the court fee could be refunded pursuant to operative part III of the order of 28 August 2026, ref. 8 Ad 9/2026-85. The letter is an administrative follow-up implementing the already ordered refund; it does not itself decide the merits of the intervention action or record a new remedy.
